MAX ATTACK
29 y.o

born to race

Dutch racer. Four-time world champion. Max made his Formula 1 debut with Toro Rosso in 2015, won on his Red Bull Racing debut in 2016, and has kept rewriting the record book ever since.

pre-f1 career2005–2014

Max began karting at four and first raced competitively in 2005. World and European karting titles followed in 2013. In 2014 he won ten European Formula 3 races, then stepped directly into Formula 1 in 2015.
